Readiness check: Confirm legal entity name and current operating address
Evidence or record to locate: Incorporation/registration record and address proof; use current official records

Readiness check: Record entity type, start date and operating locations
Evidence or record to locate: Constitution documents and current registrations

Readiness check: Keep current GST, PAN and Udyam details where applicable
Evidence or record to locate: Current registration records; applicability depends on the business

Readiness check: Maintain an authorised signatory list and approval limits
Evidence or record to locate: Board/partner authorisations and internal delegation matrix

Readiness check: Create an invoice-level outstanding list
Evidence or record to locate: Invoice number, issue/due dates, amount, customer and ageing

Readiness check: Match each unpaid invoice to its order or contract
Evidence or record to locate: Purchase order, work order, contract or accepted quotation

Readiness check: Collect delivery or service-acceptance evidence
Evidence or record to locate: Delivery proof, completion certificate, timesheet or written acceptance

Readiness check: Log every collection attempt and customer response
Evidence or record to locate: Dated email/message/call note, promised payment date and owner

Readiness check: Separate disputed, short-paid and undisputed invoices
Evidence or record to locate: Dispute reason, supporting evidence, amount in question and resolution owner

Readiness check: Confirm applicable contract terms before escalation
Evidence or record to locate: Signed terms, payment clauses, dispute-resolution terms and applicable law reviewed by adviser

Readiness check: Identify the exact scheme and official administering authority
Evidence or record to locate: Current official scheme page or notification; eligibility and process vary by scheme

Readiness check: Check current eligibility against the official criteria
Evidence or record to locate: Eligibility checklist, entity category, location, activity and cut-off dates

Readiness check: Record the official application window and submission channel
Evidence or record to locate: Official portal URL, deadline, required format and reference number

Readiness check: Assemble only the documents required by that scheme
Evidence or record to locate: Scheme-specific application, registrations, financials and declarations

Readiness check: Keep evidence of submission and follow-up
Evidence or record to locate: Acknowledgement, application ID, correspondence and response dates

Readiness check: Prepare recent financial statements and a current management view
Evidence or record to locate: Available audited/unaudited statements, latest P&L and balance sheet

Readiness check: Build a facility and repayment schedule
Evidence or record to locate: Lender, facility type, sanctioned/drawn balance, rate, maturity and repayment dates

Readiness check: Document the funding requirement and use of funds
Evidence or record to locate: Amount, purpose, timing, vendor/asset quotes and expected operating impact

Readiness check: Write down forecast assumptions and downside cases
Evidence or record to locate: Cash-flow forecast, key assumptions, sensitivity and repayment capacity

Readiness check: Reconcile existing lender/security information
Evidence or record to locate: Sanction letters, security/guarantee records, covenants and current lender statements

Readiness check: Create an item-level inventory or asset register
Evidence or record to locate: SKU/asset ID, description, quantity, location, condition and custodian

Readiness check: Record age, movement and valuation basis
Evidence or record to locate: Purchase date, last movement, cost basis and method used for any estimate

Readiness check: Attach ownership and condition evidence
Evidence or record to locate: Supplier invoice, serial number, photos, warranty or inspection record where available

Readiness check: Use an official tender or buyer source and record its URL
Evidence or record to locate: Issuing authority, tender ID, publication date and official source

Readiness check: Check deadlines, prequalification and commercial terms
Evidence or record to locate: Official tender documents; verify corrigenda, EMD/security and eligibility requirements

Readiness check: Maintain a bid/no-bid decision and submission owner
Evidence or record to locate: Decision date, fit rationale, approval, owner and submission checklist

Readiness check: Restrict access to personal, bank and customer information
Evidence or record to locate: Approved storage location, access list and retention/deletion rule

Readiness check: Redact sensitive identifiers before sharing externally
Evidence or record to locate: Redacted copy and reviewer approval; share only what the recipient needs

Readiness check: Track source, date and owner for each material record
Evidence or record to locate: Source path/link, last reviewed date and named accountable person
